title: Air Intelligence Officer (I) (LtCol to 2ndLt) NMOS (0202), DIR INTEL
raw_text:
6. MOS 0207, Air Intelligence Officer (I) (LtCol to 2ndLt) NMOS (0202), DIR
INTEL

    a. Summary. Air Intelligence Officers serve as the intelligence
functional experts at all command levels of the Marine Air Wing (MAW). They
develop and execute intelligence plans, policies, and procedures that
facilitate operations across the six functions of Marine aviation. They are
the advisors to commanders, staffs, and pilots on intelligence activities,
operations, and actions as well as the provider of intelligence products to
support mission planning and execution. They also support the overall
intelligence effort of the parent command or intelligence authority. Billets
normally include Targeting Officer, Collections Officer, Dissemination
Officer, S-2 Officer of a fixed-wing or rotary wing squadron, and
Intelligence Officer at an intelligence battalion.

       b.   Prerequisites

        (1) Security requirement: must meet sensitive compartmented
information (SCI) eligibility guidelines based on a single scope background
investigation (SSBI)/T5 investigation.

        (2) Intelligence MOS Marines are required to have a Defense Language
Aptitude Battery (DLAB) test score on file in their official military
personnel file (OMPF). Intelligence MOS Marines that score above 100 on the
DLAB may be designated to attend formal language training. There is no
minimum DLAB score required. Intelligence officers will be administered the
DLAB before being assigned the 0207 PMOS.

       c.   Requirements

        (1) Complete the Tactical Intelligence Officer Course (TIOC)
(N46CU22).




                                          1-12                   Enclosure (1)
 1105                                                               NAVMC 1200.1L



        (2) Complete the Air Intelligence Officer Course (AIOC) (N460HU2),
Marine Corps Intelligence Schools, Marine Corps Detachment Dam Neck, VA.

        (3) Upon completion of this course, Marine Corps Detachment Dam Neck
will assign PMOS 0202 and this NMOS to the Marine.

    d. Duties. For a complete listing of duties and tasks, refer to
reference (g), Intelligence Training and Readiness Manual.

    e. Related Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) Title and Code.
Command and Control Center Officers 55-1015.

       f.   Related Military Skill.   None.

nlx_method: NLx employer-demand profiles; private-only ownership unverified. Six-digit profiles pool specialty weighted task incidences after the existing review exclusion mask and five-job task-support floor; destination SOCs require 200 postings and nonzero tasks. Military profiles use binary accepted task presence and the same NLx reference RCA weights as civilian profiles: reciprocal positive task shares (zero weight for reference-absent tasks) of pooled retained support-five NLx weighted incidences across 1,016 reference specialties (912 eligible comparison candidates), sqrt(q * rca_weight), then L2 normalization and cosine. No military crosswalk codes enter the task ranking. All positive top-20 results retained; zero-similarity destinations are not recommendations. Shared field/rating duties are included; general Naval Standards remain separate by paygrade. Summary compares non-future individual source entries (versions can repeat) with nonempty reference sets; grouped, future and general-standard entries remain in all outputs. Hit@k is the fraction with at least one reference SOC recovered; ties are averaged exactly. References outside NLx remain in denominators. DMDC reference status is from July 2024, not current 2026 status.
